_purpose: Canonical, explicit dataset registry for LNES-59. This file, not directory scanning, is the sole authority for what counts as dataset content -- a *.json file in this directory that isn't listed here is invisible to every loader, by design (keeps ground-truth/holdout/scratch files out of accidental inclusion). All loaders (deterministic_extraction.py, run_case.py, arm_x2.py, validate_extraction_against_cases.py) go through dataset_registry.py's canonical functions, which verify each listed file's SHA-256 against this manifest before returning it -- a hash mismatch is a hard error, not a silent load.
